root_cause: The authorized Netlify production transport existed but only executed on a manual workflow_dispatch with deploy=true. A normal push that updated the transport workflow created a source snapshot but skipped the actual provider deploy, so production could remain on an older commit even after main advanced.
prevention_rule: For the API-sourced Netlify production lane, a push that changes the canonical production-source-snapshot workflow must execute the authorized exact-source deploy and prove exact production identity. Manual dispatch remains supported but is no longer required for this recovery path.

tests: PR #2591 Required preflight exposed missing closure artifacts for this recovery candidate.
evidence.outcome: Candidate changes the deploy/readback steps to execute on the workflow-file push as well as explicit deploy dispatch.
evidence.production_readback: Pending merge, exact-source Netlify deploy and provider production readback.
